mapper.update: update wms_tasks set task_status = case when ifnull(completed_quantity, 0) + #{execQuantity} >= quantity then 'COMPLETED' else 'EXECUTING' end, completed_at = case when ifnull(completed_quantity, 0) + #{execQuantity} >= quantity then #{now} else completed_at end, operation_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now}, completed_quantity = ifnull(completed_quantity, 0) + #{execQuantity} where id = #{id} and ifnull(completed_quantity, 0) + #{execQuantity} <= quantity and task_status in ('CREATED', 'ASSIGNED', 'EXECUTING')
